title: alchemilla vulgaris subsp. inconcinna
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris subsp. inconcinna, commonly known as Lady's Mantle, is a flowering plant species within the Rosaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to soothe menstrual cramps and promote wound healing due to its anti-inflammatory and astringent properties. The therapeutic actions of A. vulgaris subsp. inconcinna are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, inhibit bleeding, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
